statement: Whenever prime_sub_operation nums returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exists an integer array b of length n such that: (1) for every i with 0 <= i < n, either b[i] = nums[i], or (1 <= b[i] < nums[i] and nums[i] - b[i] is a prime number); (2) for every i with 0 <= i < n-1, b[i] < b[i+1] (equivalently b[0] < b[1] < ... < b[n-1]).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 1000 and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: There exists a Boolean r such that prime_sub_operation nums = Result.ok r; thus the function does not fail by panic, overflow, or out-of-bounds access on these inputs.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 1000 and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever prime_sub_operation nums returns a result r, r = false.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 1000, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000, and there exists i with 0 <= i < n and nums[i] <= i.

statement: Whenever prime_sub_operation nums returns a result r, r = true if and only if nums[0] < nums[1] < ... < nums[n-1].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 2 <= n <= 1000 and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 2.

statement: If prime_sub_operation nums returns true, then there exists an integer array b of length n such that: (1) for every i with 0 <= i < n, either b[i] = nums[i], or (1 <= b[i] < nums[i] and nums[i] - b[i] is a prime number); (2) b[0] < b[1] < ... < b[n-1]; (3) b[n-1] = nums[n-1].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 1000 and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever prime_sub_operation nums returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < n, either nums[i] = i+1, or (i+1 < nums[i] and nums[i] - (i+1) is a prime number).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 2 <= n <= 1000, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000, and nums[n-1] = n.

statement: If prime_sub_operation nums returns true, then for every l and r with 0 <= l <= r < n, prime_sub_operation on the slice nums[l], nums[l+1], ..., nums[r] returns true.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 1000 and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000.

Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 999, for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000, prime_sub_operation nums returns true, and x is an integer with 1 <= x <= 1000 and nums[n-1] < x. Let nums2 be the length n+1 array with nums2[i] = nums[i] for 0 <= i < n and nums2[n] = x.
